**Plan, no changes made.**

`buildRows()` in [report.js](src/report.js:11) already returns plain objects. `cli.js` just pipes them through `toTable`.

1. Parse `--json` out of `argv` in [cli.js](src/cli.js:8).
2. If set, print `JSON.stringify(buildRows(), null, 2)` instead of calling `toTable`.
3. Update `USAGE` string to mention the flag.

No changes needed in `report.js` or `format.js`. Want me to apply it?
